description: This Java source file defines the OverlayDataOverrider class, which implements the OverlyDataCreator interface. It overrides the createOverlayData method to return custom overlay data based on a provided map of overrides, or delegates to an original creator if no override is found.

classes.name: OverlayDataOverrider
classes.description: A class that overrides overlay data creation, providing custom data based on a map of overrides or delegating to an original creator.

methods.name: OverlayDataOverrider
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the original data creator and the overrides map.

methods.name: createOverlayData
methods.description: Creates overlay data for a given component, returning an override if available, otherwise delegating to the original creator.
